text: Mode B remains above 0.90 simulated accuracy up to a 0.49 Sybil share, but unspecified detector and update components prevent this result from establishing Sybil resistance.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reinforcement Learning from Reputation Feedback (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7456999
abstract: In this parameterized simulation, Mode B, the discrete two-round architecture, holds mean accuracy above 0.90 up to a Sybil fraction of 0.49 across 600 trials. Mode A, the continuous-coupling schedule, reaches 0.874 under the same conditions. Because the detector, dispersion statistic, threshold, false-positive and false-negative model, u p d a t e , t h e R o u n d 2 u p d a t e , a n d are unspeciﬁed, this ﬁgure is not evidence that the Sybil-resistance design objective has been achieved.
